purpose: Acceptance cases executed by tools-selftest.py. Each case builds its own fixtures in a temporary directory, drives the primary CLI through its real interface, and asserts observable outcomes. Run all: python tools-selftest.py. Run one: python tools-selftest.py --case <id>.

fixture_builders.clean-deck.pptx: 16:9 deck with claim titles, bullets, a sourced footnote, an alt-texted picture, no personal metadata; must pass the gate
fixture_builders.defect-deck.pptx: one instance of each repairable defect: low-contrast 11pt text, off-canvas box, overflowing frame, alt-text-less picture, shadowed card, near-duplicate colours, near-misaligned panels, email/API key/UNC path, TODO note, hidden obsolete slide, personal metadata
fixture_builders.edge-deck.pptx: 4:3 deck with an empty slide, zero-size shape, rotated textbox, CJK and RTL text
fixture_builders.deck-spec.json: valid declarative spec covering title, content, kpi and process slide types
fixture_builders.bad-spec.json: invalid spec: empty title, empty bullets, unknown slide type
fixture_builders.strict-config.json: profile large-stage with min_text_pt 22 and a brand allow-list
fixture_builders.corrupt.pptx: non-ZIP bytes with a PK header, used to test failure isolation
fixture_builders.blockdeps/sitecustomize.py: import hook that makes pptx and PIL unimportable, used by the deps case

cases.description: selfcheck and capabilities report a ready environment
the shipped folder structure satisfies the packaging rules
asserts: no SKILL.md in the Skill Tool folder
every file carries a tools-/knowledge-/asset- prefix

cases.description: commands degrade cleanly when optional dependencies are absent
asserts: selfcheck exits 3 and names both missing libraries
inspect without python-pptx exits 3 with a runtime message
render without Pillow exits 3 with guidance

cases.description: config validation accepts valid files and rejects invalid ones
asserts: user config merges and switches profile
invalid config exits 2 with the type error

cases.description: inspect produces a neutral model with real geometry
a clean deck audits with zero errors and a high score
the defect deck is detected and gated
asserts: defect queue ranked with an error first

cases.description: repair is dry-run-first, approved when needed, and verified after writing
alignment, spacing and colour normalization are idempotent
governance scrubs metadata, notes and sensitive text
author builds a deck from a spec and rejects an invalid spec
asserts: invalid spec exits 2 and writes nothing

cases.description: render produces real PNGs and a contact sheet
compare detects real changes and ignores unchanged decks
asserts: identical decks show no changes and identical renders
different decks show structural and visual changes

cases.description: snapshot records a reproducible model and a deck copy
asserts: snapshot usable as an audit baseline

cases.description: invalid inputs produce structured, non-crashing failures
edge-case deck (empty slide, zero size, rotation, CJK/RTL) audits without crashing
asserts: empty slide, zero-size, rotation, RTL and CJK detected

cases.description: unit conversion round-trips correctly
batch processes many decks and isolates failures
asserts: one failure recorded with a reason

cases.description: text extraction preserves slide/object context and notes
rescale reflows the canvas and needs approval
plan produces an ordered, runnable remediation sequence
the active profile changes the findings, as it must
asserts: a stricter profile reports at least as many violations
the large-stage profile flags fixture body text
